body:
@everyone
🌍 **New: translate any message in our Discord!**

Our bot can now translate messages into any of the 15 languages on our website.

**How to use it**
📱 **Phone:** long-press a message → **Apps** → **Translate**
💻 **Computer:** right-click a message → **Apps** → **Translate**

• **Translate** shows the message in your language. Only you can see it.
• **Translate to…** lets you pick from all 15 languages. Your choice is saved, so next time just tap **Translate**.
• Wrong language? Use the **Change my language** menu under any translation.

**Languages:** English, Español, Deutsch, Magyar, Nederlands, Français, Português, Українська, Polski, Türkçe, العربية, تونسي, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 繁體中文

**Arabic speakers:** Discord doesn't offer Arabic as an app language, so use **Translate to…** once and pick العربية or تونسي. After that, **Translate** remembers it.
